title: Q-SPEC-03-R16-slot-claim: A duplicate firing of the tick ends without acting
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "US-03-R16" -- seed/worker/test
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-03 (US-03-R16): the cron and the second producer (`POST /pulse/watch`, `seed/worker/src/pulse.js` `watch`) can both start a tick for one slot; `watch` only checks that the newest tick is older than two intervals and takes no claim. Take a claim on the slot (one row per slot, inserted before the steps run) so the second firing leaves a beat and returns without running a step.

size: S

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** path-level claims with tokens and fences (Q-SPEC-08-seed-fenced-claims).

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "US-03-R16" -- seed/worker/test` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
